name: @payguard/desktop
description: Local-first QVAC payment safety layer for Solana stablecoins.
author: PayGuard

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron" "npm run dev:app"
scripts.dev:app: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5174 dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.js && electronmon dist-electron/main.js
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
